notes.title: Update #5: Cats Hidden Around the World 2!
notes.notes:
This update brings a smol QoL feature: when clicking on the trash can to reset the progress of a level, there will now be a confirmation visible first instead of immediately resetting the progress.

I've also fixed a handful of tiny bugs that crept up during the development of Cats Hidden Around the World 2. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2951880/Cats_Hidden_Around_the_World_2

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update #4: Seoul, Toronto & Rio Rework
notes.notes:
All the cats and some parts of the background for the maps Seoul, Toronto and Rio de Janeiro have been reworked. 

If you have already finished the level, you can play it again by clicking the trash bin icon in the level popup. 

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update #3: Beijing Rework
notes.notes:
All the cats and also some parts of the background for the Bejing map have been reworked. If you have finished the level before already, you can play it again by clicking the trash bin icon on the level popup. 

Please let me know if you're happy with this change and which level should be updated next (I know there are a few levels people aren't particularly happy with).

Peace & Love
Patrick
